A '''[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]''' was a member of the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], and thus served as a royal advisor to [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]]. She was present in the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace's]] [[Throne room (Theed Royal Palace)/Legends|throne room]], along with [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]] and [[Graf Zapalo/Legends|Graf Zapalo]], when [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] came to see the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] to talk about the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|increasingly disturbing conflict]] with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
This character was portrayed by [[Josephine Alessio]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="ImageAttack" />
